Run R, Python, and SQL through one MCP tool.
Keep data and models between calls, work across languages, and receive text and plots without filling the model's context with raw output.

::: {.home-links}
[Get started](getting-started.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Documentation](README.md){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## One workspace, three languages

Python and SQL work without R.
With both runtimes available, use reticulate's `r.name` and `py$name` bridges to share objects.
Sessions support interactive input, package preparation, interruption, and restart.

Read [Working with R, Python, and SQL](BUILTIN_RUNTIME.md), [Configuration](CONFIGURATION.md), or [Recordings and reports](RECORDING.md).

## Status and trust

Console is a **development preview** for macOS, Linux, and [experimental Windows x64](WINDOWS.md).
Run it alongside the MCP client on the intended execution host.

The default sandbox restricts writes and direct networking but permits host-file reads, including readable secrets.
Dependency preparation has a separate policy.
See [Sandbox and trust](SANDBOX.md).
